title: Practice: Machine Gun Kick
source: Practice Mode tutorial. Added to the app's Technique Library as Muay Thai › Machine Gun Kick (cues, mistakes, next from there). Thai: te rua (เตะรัว), rapid-fire kicks. Footage: the owner's clip 21 (ring, 2026-11-02), raw-footage/practice/p21.mp4, two shots joined in InShot (cut at 5.93 s): single kicks facing the camera, then the burst from a 45° angle (kicks at about 7.2, 8.6, 9.6, 10.8, 11.7 and 12.8 s).

props.description: Rapid-fire roundhouse kicks off the same leg
props.hookSub: Machine gun kick. Te rua. 20 seconds.

cues.text: Land and reload off the same foot
cues.label: RELOAD
cues.say: Coach: "The foot touches down and comes straight back up. No reset."

cues.label: HIP
cues.say: Coach: "Each kick is a hip turn, not a leg swing. Turn it over every time."

cues.label: HANDS
cues.say: Coach: "Three kicks is three chances to get hit. The guard stays home."

watch.text: Resetting the foot too far back
watch.label: RESET
watch.say: Coach: "Step all the way back to stance and the next kick is a second away. Touch and go."
